# Components

67 components, one page each: when to use it, runnable examples, props (generated from the TypeScript source, so they cannot drift), accessibility, content guidance and tokens. The roadmap to the full set is in [roadmap.md](../roadmap.md).

## Actions

| Component | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [`Button`](button.md) | Starts an action: sending a form, enrolling, moving to the next step. |
| [`IconButton`](icon-button.md) | A button with only an icon, 44 × 44 px, always named by a required label. |
| [`ButtonGroup`](button-group.md) | Buttons that belong together, with consistent spacing and a name for assistive technology. |
| [`Link`](link.md) | An underlined link with a visible focus ring, distinct hover and visited colours, and a safe external variant. |
| [`SplitButton`](split-button.md) | A main action and an arrow that opens a menu of related actions. |
| [`ToggleButton`](toggle-button.md) | A button that stays pressed or not: follow, save, mute. |

## Data display

| Component | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [`Badge`](badge.md) | A short label for a status or category, with an icon and a border on status tones. |
| [`Avatar`](avatar.md) | A person or entity as an image or initials, with an optional presence status. |
| [`CountBadge`](count-badge.md) | A small number for pending items, such as unread notifications. |
| [`ProgramCard`](program-card.md) | A program (workshop, masterclass, membership) with a cover, badges, price, details and one action. |

## Forms

| Component | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [`Chip`](chip.md) | A toggle for filtering a list: a button with `aria-pressed` and a check when selected. |
| [`Field`](field.md) | Connects a label, a hint and an error to the control inside it. |
| [`Input`](input.md) | A one-line text field, 44 px tall, 16 px text and a 3:1 border. |
| [`Textarea`](textarea.md) | A multi-line text field with the same look as Input. |
| [`Select`](select.md) | A native select with the Kafka field look. |
| [`Checkbox`](checkbox.md) | A native checkbox with a Kafka box and mark, an optional description and an indeterminate state. |
| [`Radio`](radio.md) | A group of options of which one is chosen, with a fieldset and legend. |
| [`Switch`](switch.md) | An on/off control for settings that apply immediately. |
| [`Slider`](slider.md) | A value in a range, on the native range input. |
| [`PinInput`](pin-input.md) | A short code, one cell per character, with paste and autofill support. |
| [`TagInput`](tag-input.md) | Free-form tags that are typed and removed, each with its own button. |
| [`FileUpload`](file-upload.md) | A zone to choose or drop files, with the native file input inside. |
| [`CheckboxGroup`](checkbox-group.md) | A list of checkboxes under one question, with an optional "select all" that shows the mixed state. |
| [`RadioCardGroup`](radio-card.md) | A single choice presented as cards, each with a title, a description, an icon and an optional badge. |
| [`SegmentedControl`](segmented-control.md) | A strip of two to five mutually exclusive options, one always selected: a view, a format, a period. |
| [`ThemeToggle`](theme-toggle.md) | Light, dark or system. |
| [`Combobox`](combobox.md) | A text field with a filtered list of options. |
| [`Calendar`](calendar.md) | A month grid for choosing a date. |
| [`DatePicker`](date-picker.md) | A date field that can be typed or picked from a calendar. |
| [`InlineEdit`](inline-edit.md) | A short text that is edited in place: it looks like text, becomes a field on click and goes back when saved. |
| [`InputGroup`](input-group.md) | An input with fixed text, an icon or one button attached to its sides: units, prefixes, a search action. |

| [`Accordion`](accordion.md) | Titles that expand and collapse their content in place. |

| [`Pagination`](pagination.md) | Moves between numbered pages of a long list. |

| Component | Use it for |
|---|---|

## Reading

| Component | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [`Prose`](prose.md) | The reading column: styles paragraphs, headings, lists, links, block quotes and rules inside a 66-character line. |
| [`PullQuote`](pull-quote.md) | A quotation set apart from the text with a gold rule, in the reading typeface and italic. |
| [`Footnote`](footnote.md) | A numbered call in the text, a list of notes at the end, and a link back from each note. |
| [`Verse`](verse.md) | A poem: verse breaks and stanzas are kept, and long verses wrap with a hanging indent. |
| [`Epigraph`](epigraph.md) | A short quotation that opens a text, set to the right in a softer tone. |
| [`DropCap`](drop-cap.md) | A paragraph whose first letter is a large gold initial, made with CSS so the text stays one ordinary paragraph. |
| [`ReadingProgress`](reading-progress.md) | A thin bar that fills as the reader moves through the text. |
| [`TableOfContents`](toc.md) | A navigation list of the sections of a text, with the current one marked. |
| [`ReadingSettings`](reading-settings.md) | The reader's controls: text size, line width, typeface and theme. |
| [`PrevNext`](prev-next.md) | Links to the texts before and after this one, with their titles. |
| [`Figure`](figure.md) | An image with a caption and a credit, cropped to a ratio. |
| [`Author`](author.md) | A byline: portrait or initials, name, role and an optional bio. |
| [`ReadingTime`](reading-time.md) | Estimated reading time, calculated from the word count. |
| [`Embed`](embed.md) | A titled, sandboxed frame for third-party content (Genially, video, maps), with a link to open it on its own. |

| Component | Use it for |
|---|---|
